You are {me}, one of six villagers in a snowed-in village in winter: Ada, Eli, Fay, Cal, Dev, Ben. It lasts 5 days.

The storehouse starts with 6 rations.

Every day, all villagers act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next morning. It may be empty.
- claim: how many rations to take from the storehouse.
- give: rations to other living villagers, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the storehouse receives between 2 and 6 rations, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole rations (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the storehouse.

Each night, every villager eats one ration: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the storehouse, given by lot if there are not enough. A villager who gets none dies.

Ada.say: Ada here. The storehouse cannot feed all six of us for five nights: we need 30 rations in total, and at most about 26 will arrive (6 now plus up to 4 a day). Grabbing rations so we all end up short helps nobody. Proposal: claim nothing today so the 6 stay in storehouse and the delivery is visible to everyone. Then let's agree on a plan to split what we have so that as many of us as possible reach five rations, rather than all of us starving. I'm open to giving priority to whoever can be fed most efficiently. Please reply with your own ideas.

Eli.say: Eli here. Storehouse has only 6 plus 2-6 delivered per day, and we need 30 rations total to get everyone through 5 nights, so not everyone can survive. Proposal: rations go to whoever can be fully fed, and then we pass spares along. I'm claiming all 6 now so I can last all 5 nights. Everyone else, please don't claim today, so the delivery stays put for the next rounds. Tell me what you're holding and we can plan who gets the next claims.

Fay.say: Fay here. The storehouse only holds 6 and the total needed for all six of us to last 5 nights is 30, so we can't all survive. If everyone claims at once, the pool gets split so thin that nobody gets enough. Proposal: one person claims 5 per day, which the pool (8-12 after delivery) can cover in full, so that person is guaranteed 5 and lasts the full 5 nights. I'll claim 5 today and share what I have left with anyone who needs it later. Please don't all claim at once. Let's decide on a rotation for the next days.

I propose we concentrate claims so that as many of us as possible reach 5 rations. I'm claiming 5 today. Please post your claims so we can agree who takes what each day, and share any surplus with whoever is closest to starving.
